name: Hillsbrad restored quests: the map marks each objective area and the turn-in
contract: rev_20261027_85_coa_hillsbrad_quest_markers.sql gives the 60 restored Hillsbrad quests their world map markers: one POI per objective area, from the client QuestSuperTrack points, and a turn-in pin (ObjectiveIndex -1) on each quest's ender; For Want of Mana 255128's pin stands at Asteria the Soulcleaver. Four characters carry every quest (a quest log holds 25) and send the CMSG_QUEST_POI_QUERY a real client sends; each SMSG_QUEST_POI_QUERY_RESPONSE must list exactly those POIs, with their objective index, map area, point count and first point. A control query for 17003, which no character carries, comes back empty.
